pool.text: Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama saw the coast and named it Natal.
English traders established a trading post at Port Natal under Francis and Henry.
The settlement was named after the governor of Cape Colony, Sir Benjamin D'Urban.
The Durban settlement officially became a designated borough.
Indentured labourers from British India began arriving in Durban.
Natal colony became a province of the Union of South Africa.
Durban was granted official city status.
The African Art Centre was founded to support artists and crafters.
The city became part of the Durban UniCity as part of transitional arrangements.
The city transitioned to the eThekwini Metropolitan Municipality governance system.
Durban hosted matches for the FIFA World Cup event.
James Nxumalo was elected as the new mayor after local elections.
Zandile Gumede was elected as the new mayor of the municipality.
The African Art Centre relocated to a new home in Station Drive.
A brand new R200 million cruise terminal began its operation.
Mxolisi Kaunda was sworn in as the new mayor of Durban.
The eThekwini Metropolitan Municipality population reached 4.2 million.
A casting call was held for a new theatrical musical production.
Domestic trips reached an estimated 1.8 million between January and May.
